description_en: Invokes the AddLhMembers operation to add storage management administrators, workspace members, or node flow developers to a Data Management Service (DMS) data warehouse development project workspace
description_zh: 调用AddLhMembers接口，添加DMS数仓开发项目空间管理员、空间成员或任务流开发者
name: AddLhMembers

parameters.help_en:
The object type. Valid values:
0: project workspace
1: task flow
parameters.help_zh:
对象类型，取值如下：
0：项目空间
1：任务流
parameters.name: object_type

parameters.help_en:
The object ID:

Project workspace ID (Id). You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424379.html operation to obtain this value.
Task flow ID (Id). You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/426672.html operation to obtain this value
parameters.help_zh:
对象ID：

项目空间ID（Id），可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424379.html获取该参数的值。
任务流ID（Id），可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/426672.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: object_id

element_fields.help_en: The user ID of the user to be added. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141938.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147098.html operation to obtain this value
element_fields.help_zh: 需添加用户的用户ID，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141938.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147098.html获取该参数的值
element_fields.name: user_id

parameters.help_en: The list of target user information
parameters.name: members

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198074.html operation to obtain this value
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198074.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: tid
